F5.feasibility_note: Payload serialization (60.32us) exceeds cycle duration (50us) at 100Mbps, which violates CQF single-cycle transmission. Reported WCD ignores this violation; strict CQF scheduling is infeasible without increasing cycle time or link speed, or reducing frame size.

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = (N_sw + 1) * T + L * t_prop + N_sw * t_sw + L * (payload_B * 8 / bandwidth_bps) + (N_sw + 1) * t_sync

where.N_sw: number of switches on the path
where.L: number of links (hop_count from the route)
where.t_sw: switching delay per switch (1 us, cut-through)
where.t_sync: time synchronization error margin per CQF cycle boundary (1 us)

notes: CQF pipeline contributes (N_sw + 1) cycles for end-to-end bounded latency.
Serialization delay is added per link using payload bytes only.
Time sync error is conservatively added once per CQF cycle boundary, i.e., (N_sw + 1) times.
Feasibility condition: payload serialization must fit within T; F5 violates this at 100 Mbps with T=50 us.

missing_inputs: Exact CQF gate control lists (GCL) per egress port to resolve multi-flow per-cycle allocation and potential extra-cycle backlogs.
Layer-2 frame overhead (MAC header, VLAN tag, FCS, preamble, IFG) to refine serialization times.
Policy for frames whose serialization time exceeds the CQF cycle (fragmentation/disallow/longer cycle); F5 currently infeasible under strict CQF at 50 us and 100 Mbps.
Clarification whether end-stations implement CQF gating on the first hop (assumed: no, scheduling begins at first switch).
Any reserved guard bands per cycle/window for PCP 7 (assumed none or negligible).
